ValidationRule.description: FB-704: previously exempted every insert, so a Lead could be created with a past delivery date. Now fires on create and on change. System Administrator is exempt so historical leads can be data-migrated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(GoLive_Target_Date__c)), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(GoLive_Target_Date__c)), GoLive_Target_Date__c < TODAY(), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Requested Delivery Date should be greater than today.
